title: Gyan Singh v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: B. Amit Sthalekar and Manju Rani Chauhan, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner directed to Clause 6.8 objection; recovery citation stayed pending Executive Engineer’s decision.
headnote: A writ seeking quashing of a recovery citation for electricity dues, where the recovery is not disputed to be in pursuance of theft, is not decided on merits. The consumer has an alternative remedy of representation or objection before the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.8 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The citation was kept in abeyance subject to a time-bound decision on that objection.
facts: Gyan Singh sought quashing of a recovery citation dated 22 December 2018 for Rs.1,21,821 towards electricity dues. An FIR had been lodged against him, and he had filed a complaint before the Chief Judicial Magistrate against officials of the Electricity Department, which remained pending. It was not disputed that the recovery was in pursuance of an allegation of theft. The Division Bench did not examine the assessment and instead treated Clause 6.8 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as the forum for the petitioner's objection.

holding_units.holding: A consumer facing a recovery citation for electricity dues founded on an admitted theft allegation has an alternative remedy of representation or objection before the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.8 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ was disposed with a direction that, if the petitioner appears on the appointed date with the objection and a certified copy of the order, the Executive Engineer shall consider and decide it in accordance with law within two weeks; the citation remains in abeyance subject to that decision.
holding_units.flag: Court applied Clause 6.8 (UUE procedure) to a theft recovery; Clauses 8.1–8.2 not addressed.

not_decided.point: Sustainability of the Rs.1,21,821 theft assessment and recovery citation on merits
The pending complaint before the Chief Judicial Magistrate against electricity officials
